complete_examples.text: One can observe from Fig. 9(a) that the PDFs of W/R VF will be changed along with the failures of rail fasteners, especially when the failing number reaches 4, the variation scope of W/R VF will almost reach the limits, namely W/R VF=0 that indicates wheel off the rail, and W/R VF=170 which is the limit of maximum vertical force.
